comparison.position: 固定环境动力学而进化奖励目标，用受训练策略的全种群交叉适应度区分目标引发的真实行为；本地仅论文数学评价和选择。
comparison.tradeoff: AlphaEvolve在人固定评价合同下进化候选程序；Habitats改奖励及其评价坐标，跨代profile不可直接当固定基准比较。两者本库无完整发现能力证据。
sections: 论文与作者源码的区别

analysis.title: 目标发现与固定目标程序搜索的评价坐标不同
analysis.body: 先分清进化对象与评价合同：AlphaEvolve改程序而人固定目标，Habitats在固定动力学中改奖励、从头训练新策略，用策略×奖励交叉矩阵观察mastery/transfer。SQ/BD依赖本代reward坐标，GC先grounding再量化去重、逐代累加，不是跨代唯一技能数。高质量或高多样性数学值不能替代真实Planner/Mutator与RL。作者源码归一化和固定论文不同，本地必须声明选择的口径；完整小时级CPU/H100及多模型矩阵终态不复现，不以CPU公式核重开实验或晋级Evolve。

question.question: Habitats与AlphaEvolve都改代码，为什么不能把它们当同一种自进化？
question.answer: AlphaEvolve由人固定任务和评价合同，进化满足该评价的程序；Habitats固定环境动力学却进化奖励目标，再训练策略，用全策略×全奖励profile评价学到的行为。它们改变的对象与评价坐标不同，不能比较代码数量就断言能力胜负。
question.example: 教学例：优化同一个矩阵乘法评价器下的程序是AlphaEvolve式固定目标；在同一纸牌环境发现清手、收牌等不同目标是Habitats式目标发现，两者都还需实际执行验证。

update.summary: 固定环境动力学而进化奖励目标，用受训练策略的全种群交叉适应度区分目标引发的真实行为；本地仅论文数学评价和选择。 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；数学核非能力证据。

comparison.position: Evolve reward objectives under fixed dynamics and compare trained-policy cross-fitness profiles; the local scope is paper mathematics and selection only.
comparison.tradeoff: AlphaEvolve evolves candidate programs under a human-fixed evaluator. Habitats changes rewards and evaluation coordinates; cross-generation profiles are not a fixed benchmark. Neither local entry establishes full discovery capability.

analysis.title: Objective discovery and fixed-objective program search use different evaluation coordinates
analysis.body: Separate the evolutionary object from its evaluator. AlphaEvolve changes programs under a fixed human objective; Habitats changes rewards under fixed dynamics and trains new policies, using policy-by-reward profiles for mastery and transfer. SQ/BD use within-generation coordinates. GC grounds, quantizes and deduplicates within each generation before summing, not counting unique skills across time. Numerical quality/diversity does not replace real Planner/Mutator or RL. The pinned source and paper normalize differently, so the chosen convention must be explicit. The hour-scale CPU/H100 and multi-model campaign remains terminally not reproduced; a CPU kernel neither reopens it nor qualifies for Evolve.

question.question: Why are Habitats and AlphaEvolve different forms of code evolution?
question.answer: AlphaEvolve evolves programs under a human-fixed task and evaluator. Habitats fixes environment dynamics but evolves reward objectives, trains policies and compares policy-by-reward profiles. Their changing objects and evaluation coordinates differ; code counts do not establish a capability winner.
question.example: Teaching example: improving matrix multiplication under one evaluator keeps the objective fixed; discovering clearing-versus-collecting objectives in one card environment changes objectives. Both still require executed validation.
